title: Separate demo calibration observations
description: Store demo observations under explicit demo provenance, display persistent demo labeling, and make all physical-evidence and profile gates refuse demo records even after restart or portability round trips.
acceptanceCriteria: Demo provenance is explicit, immutable, and queryably distinct from operator-entered physical provenance
Demo labeling remains visible in entry, review, diagnostics, restoration, and exported/imported state
No demo observation can satisfy a physical-evidence transition or profile gate
Mixed demo and physical collections exclude demo values from physical qualification

steps.details: Add an immutable demo provenance variant and schema rules that prevent relabeling it as physical provenance.
Make transition and future qualification boundaries reject or filter demo records with a stable reason code.
Render semantic demo warnings in entry, review, diagnostics, and restored-draft states without relying on color.
Cover restart, serialization, mixed collections, export/import participation, relabel attempts, and physical-gate refusal.

technicalNotes: Maximum execution scope is ten minutes; implement one provenance variant and focused gate tests.
Synthetic or demo values are never substitutes for physical observations.
